name: Dr Simon Kinsella
title: Psychologist
description: Simon is a co-founder and director of CP Consulting, and co-founder and Chief Science Officer at Simpatico Ai. He has been a practicing clinical psychologist for over 30 years.
specialties: Sexual difficulties, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy

name: Elizabeth Reilly
title: Contact Psychologist
description: I am a Clinical Psychologist and ANZAED Credentialed Eating Disorder Clinician (Mental Health) who works thoughtfully within a strengths-based and trauma-informed framework. I ensure the therapeutic environment is experienced as safe and supportive for all clients through a non-judgemental, caring and collaborative approach. Treatment is tailored to meet individual needs utilising a range of evidence-based modalities including Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), Schema Therapy, EMDR, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Motivational Interviewing, Solution-Focused Therapy and Exposure Response Prevention (ERP). My clients include people dealing with anxiety, depression, obsessive compulsive disorder, panic, grief, loss, trauma, relationships, body image, sleep, stress, menopause, pain management and adjustment difficulties.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Peta Stephenson
title: Psychologist
description: Hello, I'm Peta, a psychologist dedicated to fostering positive change and wellbeing. In our sessions, I aim to create a nurturing space where you feel understood and empowered, equipping you with tools to manage emotions and improve relationships in both personal and professional areas.

name: Blake Davis
title: Psychologist
description: Blake takes a humanistic approach in his work, respecting each individual's dignity, agency, and experiences. He aims to foster a safe and productive therapeutic relationship, where your concerns can be heard, understood, and addressed. He is a clinical psychology registrar with experience working with clients across the lifespan, including those from diverse backgrounds, experiencing anxiety, behavioural difficulties, panic attacks, trauma, depression, attentional and hyperactivity concerns, and difficulties related to autism.
specialties: Sexual difficulties, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Amy Maughan
title: Psychologist
address: Suite 11, 520 Victoria St, Melbourne Integrated Psychology
description: Availability: NEW CLIENTS WELCOME! Send me a text message, email or call Many clients recognise patterns in their mental health but aren't sure how to improve their lived experience. Areas of Support: Anxiety, depression, grief, PTSD, OCD, study, work, adulting, communication, relationships, break-ups, new diagnoses, sex positivity, parenting, and aging. My Approach: Trauma-informed, friendly, and sincere, emphasising collaboration and practical solutions.

name: Jasmine Randone
title: Psychologist
description: Jasmine is a clinical psychologist who works with adolescents and adults. She has specific interest working with people who feel stuck in behavioural or relational patterns that no longer serve them. She works with trauma (including complex and attachment trauma) interpersonal challenges, personality difficulties, mood dysregulation, OCD, anxiety, abandonment fears, shame/self-criticism and people pleasing. Her interventions include schema therapy, CBT, ERP and ACT.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, Sex worker issues, Schema Therapy

name: Trevor Rule
title: Psychologist
description: My particular skills and interest as a therapist are in assisting people to address psychological issues such as fears and worries, low mood, psychological trauma, and interpersonal relationship difficulties. I also enjoy the challenge of working with more complex issues that may be present in the context of developmental concerns, physical health difficulties, or alcohol or other substance use.
specialties: Sexual abuse, Sexual difficulties, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy

name: Dr Sharon Horne
title: Psychologist
description: Relationship and Couples Counselling: My practice has a particular focus on relationships, intimacy and sexuality. I work with couples across a wide range of concerns including communication difficulties, aftermath of an affair, rekindling intimacy, and sexual wellbeing, to help couples develop greater understanding, communication and connection within their relationships. I have a longstanding professional and academic interest in sexuality and relationships and completed my PhD examining female sexuality, desire and sexual selves.
specialties: Sexual difficulties, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy
